description: This file defines a Catalyst controller for importing recipes in a web application. It includes methods for setting up the import process, previewing import options, and submitting the import form, interacting with models and generating URLs.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Recipe::Import
classes.description: A Catalyst controller class handling recipe import workflows, including setup, preview, and submission.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Chained method to initialize the import process, loading the recipe and importer models, and setting them in stash.

methods.name: preview
methods.description: Handles the preview step of recipe import, preparing data for display, including article units and recipe name adjustments.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Processes the submitted import form, validates data, creates a new recipe, and redirects to editing.
